# Mehmood Ul Haq

> AI Engineering Officer at NESPAK and M.S. Data Science student at the University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Lahore, Pakistan. Research in solar-energy forecasting, explainable machine learning for engineering materials, and computer vision.
